# dify_app (Data Source)

Reads a Dify application by `id` or exact `name` (exactly one required).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an app by ID or by exact name (exactly one is required).
data "dify_app" "by_id" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

data "dify_app" "by_name" {
  name = "My Workflow"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) App ID to read. Exactly one of `id` or `name` is required.
- `name` (String) Exact app name to look up. Exactly one of `id` or `name` is required.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) App description.
- `mode` (String) App mode.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
